svg.title: HIL testbed architecture, landscape
svg.desc: Left-to-right pipeline: entry points feed model building, then the benchmark_runner orchestrator, which dispatches six scenario runners each with its own control mechanism. Every scenario uses a shared engine (violation_detector, scenario_result, pandapower). Only Volt-Var drives the ordered HIL stack of volt_var_controller, sensitivity_coordinator, der_dynamics and the Arduino. Hosting capacity is a separate study; results are serialised by publisher and read by the notebook, Streamlit and plotting consumers.
